title: Roswell crash and Stringfield's Marcel interview
summary: Richard Dolan tells of Roswell crash and Stringfield's Marcel interview, about 1947; late 1970s at Roswell, New Mexico, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and he was one of the per first people to interview and publish his interview with Jesse Marcel Senior.

plain: Richard Dolan, a historian of UFO claims, talks on Jesse Michels's podcast about Roswell, a town in New Mexico where something is said to have crashed in 1947. Dolan says Leonard Stringfield, a researcher who gathered stories of crashed flying saucers, was one of the first people to interview and publish an interview with Jesse Marcel Senior, a military officer who handled the Roswell debris, in the late 1970s. He tells it as part of how the Roswell story came back into public view.
